Agents panel activity metrics stream; payload carries `agentId` + `type` + open envelope. Reverse-engineered from useAgentMetricsSSE.ts; deck-go middleware is a transparent SSE pipe (stream.go), so any upstream drift is caught by the backend narrowing test stream_event_typing_test.go.

Agent busy/idle status transition. `status` is `"busy" | "idle"` today with `(string & {})` extension to tolerate new upstream values without a contract change. Backend narrowing test asserts this in stream_event_typing_test.go.
